Real Hummus
By: Sarah
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 5:37pm

Ingredients




1 can of drained chick peas
1 squeezed lemon (remove the seeds)
1 tablespoon of tahini sauce
2 garlic cloves
1 teaspoon paprika
1 teaspoon of olive oil
Red onion

Syrian bread (aka fresh pita bread)

Preparation

1 Combine peas, lemon, tahini, and garlic together in a food processor. Blend until smooth. 2 Spoon out onto a plate 3 Drizzle olive oil on top 4 Sprinkle paprika on top 5 Serve with chunks of red onion and Syrian bread on the side
